functions.name: rw_password_changed
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rw_password_changed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if old.encrypted_password is distinct from new.encrypted_password and coalesce(old.encrypted_password,'')<>'' then
 update public.rw_members set password_changed=true where user_id=new.id and role='student';
 end if;
 return new;
end $function$

functions.name: rw_today
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rw_today(p_task uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(student_id uuid, student_name text, learned bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
select m.user_id,m.display_name,count(p.word_index)
from public.rw_members m left join public.rw_progress p on p.user_id=m.user_id and p.task_id=p_task and p.learned_on=(now() at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')::date
where m.role='student' and exists(select 1 from public.rw_members teacher where teacher.user_id=auth.uid() and teacher.role='teacher')
group by m.user_id,m.display_name order by m.display_name,m.user_id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rw_enroll_created_student()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin
if new.raw_app_meta_data ? 'rw_student_name' then
insert into public.rw_members(user_id,role,display_name) values(new.id,'student',left(new.raw_app_meta_data->>'rw_student_name',30)) on conflict (user_id) do nothing;
end if; return new; end $function$

functions.name: rw_dashboard
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rw_dashboard()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin
if not exists(select from public.rw_members where user_id=auth.uid() and role='teacher') then raise exception 'teacher required';end if;
return jsonb_build_object('members',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)),'[]') from(select user_id,display_name,cohort from public.rw_members where role='student')s),'learned',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)),'[]') from(select p.user_id,lower(trim(t.words->p.word_index->>'en')) word,max(p.learned_on) last_day from public.rw_progress p join public.rw_tasks t on t.id=p.task_id group by 1,2)s),'checked',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(distinct s.user_id),'[]') from(select p.user_id from public.rw_progress p join public.rw_tasks t on t.id=p.task_id where p.learned_on=(now() at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')::date group by p.user_id,t.id,t.words having count(*)>=jsonb_array_length(t.words))s),'answers',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)),'[]') from(select student,word,count(*) n,count(*) filter(where correct) hits from public.rw_answers where at>=date_trunc('week',now() at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai') at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai' group by 1,2)s));end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rw_move_student(p_student uuid, p_cohort text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
if not exists(select from public.rw_members where user_id=auth.uid() and role='teacher') or p_cohort not in ('七年级','八年级第一班','八年级第二班','九年级强化班') or p_cohort is null then raise exception 'invalid assignment';end if;
update public.rw_members set cohort=p_cohort where user_id=p_student and role='student';end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rw_student_summary()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with member as (select * from public.rw_members where user_id=auth.uid() and role='student' and password_changed),
days as(select p.learned_on,p.task_id,count(*) n,jsonb_array_length(t.words) total from public.rw_progress p join member m on m.user_id=p.user_id join public.rw_tasks t on t.id=p.task_id where p.learned_on>=date_trunc('week',now() at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')::date group by 1,2,t.words),
answers as(select a.correct from public.rw_answers a join member m on m.user_id=a.student where a.at>=date_trunc('week',now() at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai') at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')
select jsonb_build_object('today',(select count(distinct lower(trim(t.words->p.word_index->>'en'))) from public.rw_progress p join member m on m.user_id=p.user_id join public.rw_tasks t on t.id=p.task_id where p.learned_on=(now() at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')::date),'days',(select count(distinct learned_on) from days where n>=total),'accuracy',(select round(avg(correct::int)*100) from answers),'cohort',(select cohort from member))
$function$

functions.name: rw_vocabulary_periods
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rw_vocabulary_periods()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with clock as (
 select now() as instant,now() at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai' as local_now
), periods as (
 select p, date_trunc(p,local_now)::date as start_day,local_now::date as today,instant
 from clock cross join (values('week'),('month'),('year')) v(p)
), events as (
 select lower(regexp_replace(trim(word),'\s+',' ','g')) word,at
 from public.rw_answers
 where student=auth.uid() and correct and at>=((select min(start_day)::timestamp from periods) at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')
 union all
 select lower(regexp_replace(trim(a->>'word'),'\s+',' ','g')),b.at
 from public.rw_book_tests b cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(b.answers) a
 where b.student=auth.uid() and a->>'correct'='true'
 and b.at>=((select min(start_day)::timestamp from periods) at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')
), first_answers as (
 select p,word,min((at at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')::date) first_day
 from periods join events on at>=start_day::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai' and at<=instant
 where word is not null and word<>'' group by p,word
), buckets as (
 select p,start_day,today,generate_series(start_day::timestamp,
 case when p='year' then date_trunc('month',today::timestamp) else today::timestamp end,
 case when p='year' then interval '1 month' else interval '1 day' end)::date as bucket_day
 from periods
), points as (
 select b.p,b.start_day,b.today,b.bucket_day,count(f.word) total
 from buckets b left join first_answers f on f.p=b.p and
 f.first_day<=case when b.p='year' then least(b.today,(b.bucket_day+interval '1 month'-interval '1 day')::date) else b.bucket_day end
 group by b.p,b.start_day,b.today,b.bucket_day
), series as (
 select p,jsonb_build_object('start',min(start_day),'end',max(today),'total',max(total),
 'points',jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('day',bucket_day,'total',total) order by bucket_day)) data
 from points group by p
) select jsonb_object_agg(p,data) from series
$function$

rw_passed_periods
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rw_passed_periods()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with clock as (
 select now() as instant,now() at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai' as local_now
), periods as (
 select p,date_trunc(p,local_now) as starts,local_now,instant,
 date_trunc(p,local_now)+case p when 'day' then interval '1 day' when 'week' then interval '7 days' when 'month' then interval '1 month' else interval '1 year' end as ends,
 case p when 'day' then interval '1 hour' when 'year' then interval '1 month' else interval '1 day' end as step
 from clock cross join (values('day'),('week'),('month'),('year')) v(p)
), events as (
 select lower(regexp_replace(trim(a->>'word'),'\s+',' ','g')) as word,t.at
 from public.rw_group_tests t cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(t.answers) a
 where t.student=auth.uid() and jsonb_array_length(t.answers)>0
 and t.correct::numeric/nullif(jsonb_array_length(t.answers),0)>=0.9
 and a->>'correct'='true'
 and t.at>=((select min(starts) from periods) at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')
 and t.at<=(select instant from clock)
), first_pass as (
 select p,word,min(at at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai') as first_at
 from periods join events on at>=(starts at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')
 where word is not null and word<>'' group by p,word
), buckets as (
 select p,starts,ends,local_now,step,generate_series(starts,ends-step,step) as bucket_at from periods
), points as (
 select b.p,b.starts,b.ends,b.local_now,b.bucket_at,
 case when b.bucket_at>b.local_now then null else count(f.word) end as total
 from buckets b left join first_pass f on f.p=b.p and f.first_at>=b.bucket_at and f.first_at<b.bucket_at+b.step
 group by b.p,b.starts,b.ends,b.local_now,b.bucket_at
), series as (
 select p,jsonb_build_object('start',min(starts)::date,'end',(max(ends)-interval '1 day')::date,'asOf',max(local_now)::date,
 'total',coalesce(sum(total),0),
 'points',jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('day',to_char(bucket_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'),'total',total) order by bucket_at)) data
 from points group by p
) select jsonb_object_agg(p,data) from series
$function$

functions.name: mastery_source
mastery_summary
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rw_private.mastery_summary(p_kind text, p_source uuid, p_mode text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare b jsonb; pool jsonb; report jsonb;
begin
 b:=rw_private.mastery_source(p_kind,p_source);pool:=b->'words';
 if p_mode not in ('reading','writing') then raise exception 'invalid_mode';end if;
 with population as (
  select w->>'word_key' key,(w->>'difficulty')::int level from jsonb_array_elements(pool) w
 ), events as (
  select r->>'word_key' key,(r->>'correct')::boolean correct,s.submitted_at at,s.id,
   row_number() over(partition by r->>'word_key' order by s.submitted_at desc,s.id desc) rank
  from public.rw_mastery_sessions s cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(s.results) r
  join population p on p.key=r->>'word_key'
  where s.student=auth.uid() and s.source_key=b->>'source_key' and s.mode=p_mode and s.status='completed'
    and not coalesce((r->>'assisted')::boolean,false)
 ), latest as (
  select * from events where rank=1
 ), delayed as (
  select l.key from latest l
  where l.correct and exists(
   select 1 from events e where e.key=l.key and e.correct and e.at<=l.at-interval '24 hours'
   and not exists(select 1 from events bad where bad.key=l.key and not bad.correct and bad.at>=e.at and bad.at<=l.at)
  )
 ), levels as (
  select p.level,count(*) n,count(l.key) tested,count(*) filter(where l.correct) correct
  from population p left join latest l using(key) group by p.level
 )
 select jsonb_build_object(
  'total',(select count(*) from population),
  'tested',(select count(*) from latest),
  'correct',(select count(*) from latest where correct),
  'delayed',(select count(*) from delayed),
  'coverage',coalesce(round(100.0*(select count(*) from latest)/nullif((select count(*) from population),0)),0),
  'estimate',case when min(tested)>0 and sum(tested)>=least(5,sum(n)) then
   case when sum(tested)=sum(n) then round(100.0*sum(correct)/nullif(sum(n),0))
    else 5*round(20.0*sum(n*correct::numeric/nullif(tested,0))/nullif(sum(n),0)) end else null end,
  'last_test',(select max(at) from latest),
  'ungraded',(select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(pool) w where not coalesce((w->>'graded')::boolean,false))
 ) into report from levels;
 return report;
end $function$
